entries.069ce362560aa26b: The company, together with 58 [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] and 20 affiliates (as of March 31, 2026), conducts the 4 businesses of Chemicals, Food, Life Science and Others. Chemicals, Food and Life Science are the 3 [[term:segment|reportable segments]], and Chemicals is divided into the 3 categories of resin additives, [[term:semiconductor|semiconductor]] materials and environmental materials. It is a business that sells the products it makes to companies in Japan and overseas, and the annual securities report states that the company's products are used as industrial intermediate materials in a wide range of industries. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥416,563 million, and net sales to external customers were ¥214,810 million for Chemicals, ¥111,797 million for Life Science and ¥83,003 million for Food. Its main raw materials are petrochemical raw materials and oils and fats raw materials, and their purchase prices are affected by market conditions in Japan and overseas and by exchange rates.

entries.62dcec4ec091cf31: Chemicals are divided into three categories (resin additives, semiconductor materials and environmental materials) and produce products such as additives for polyolefins, high-purity semiconductor materials, epoxy resins and lubricant additives. Food includes margarine-type products, shortening, fats and oils for chocolate and plant-based foods, and life science includes agricultural chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, veterinary drugs, wood preservatives and medical materials. Products that management's analysis in the securities report described as strong or steady for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were mainly semiconductor lithography materials for advanced photoresists, heat stabilizers for PVC used in electric wires, lubricant additives for automotive engine oils, the 'Delicplants' series centered on plant-based cheese, and agricultural chemicals in Europe, North America and Japan.

entries.653f1dedd00415fb: This segment manufactures and sells epoxy resins, polyurethane raw materials, water-based resins, surfactants, lubricant additives, kitchen cleaning agents, cosmetic ingredients, propylene glycols, hydrogen peroxide and derivatives, water-swellable sealing materials, battery materials and other products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue and profit increased, and revenue rose 1.8% from the previous fiscal year. In Asia and the United States, lubricant additives for automobile engine oil and specialty epoxy resins for electronic components performed well. Photocurable resins for displays were solid, and reactive emulsifiers, whose uses expanded to adhesives and other applications despite the impact of the slump in construction demand in China, were also solid. Effective April 1, 2025, electronics-related materials that had been included in the former "Electronic Materials" were included in this segment.

entries.788b748a5b40aef3: This business manufactures and sells margarines, shortening, fats and oils for chocolate, fats and oils for frying and cooking, plant-based foods, whipped cream, cream for kneading into dough, fillings, mayonnaise and dressings, functional food ingredients and other products. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥83,003 million (up 0.6% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for 19.9% of consolidated revenue, and revenue increased and profit decreased. In Japan, sales of high-function kneading ingredients that contribute to reducing food production losses and of the "Deli Plants" series, centered on plant-based cheese, were solid. In China, where the economic slump continues, sales of shortening and margarines used in bread and confectionery were weak.
entries.79c77192bd0542ea: This business manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, veterinary drugs, wood preservatives, medical materials and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥111,797 million (up 11.8% year on year), equivalent to 26.8% of consolidated revenue, and both revenue and profit increased. The 'Business Description' section of the securities report lists Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd. first among its principal affiliates; it is a consolidated subsidiary in which the company holds 51.00% of the voting rights. During the period, herbicides for fruit trees and potatoes performed well in Europe, and insecticides for fruit trees and nuts also performed well in the United States. In Japan, rising rice prices boosted farmers' production motivation and increased the planted area of paddy rice, so herbicides and insecticides for paddy rice and others performed well.

entries.b2ef327b7df0c3bc: This segment manufactures and sells high-purity semiconductor materials, photoacid generators and other products. entries.c4914f875a75769b: This segment manufactures and sells additives for polyolefins, stabilizers and plasticizers for PVC, flame retardants and other products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue and profit decreased, and revenue fell 6.7% from the previous fiscal year. With the slump in the home appliance and EV markets continuing, and with intensifying price competition, sales of flame retardants were weak, mainly in Europe and the United States. Production slowed in the petrochemical market, and sales of antioxidants, which are used in plastic products in general, were also weak. On the other hand, against the background of expanding investment in data centers, PVC stabilizers for electric wires performed well.

entries.c8e449ae7ae3ee63: The securities report says the company's group products are used as industrial intermediate materials across a wide range of industries. Applications include semiconductors (advanced photoresists and the latest-generation DRAM), components for home appliances and automobiles, electric wires, electronic components, displays, bakery and confectionery products, and agriculture. Dividing revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by customer location: Japan ¥189,997 million, China ¥35,030 million, other Asia ¥76,149 million, and other regions ¥115,386 million. No customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue. Under “Material Contracts,” the securities report states that Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd. has a basic agreement on the sale and purchase of agrochemical products with Zen-Noh (National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations), dated December 11, 2003 and ongoing.
